record R(p: path)
record Seed(n: number, pad: number)
module Pick(which: number) {
 const A: Seed = Seed(n: 3, pad: 7)
 const B: Seed = Seed(n: 5, pad: 11)
 const Values: Seed[] = [@A, @B]
 const Mapped: R[] = for item in @Values { R(p: segment(start: (0, 0), end: (@item.pad, 0))) }
 const Chosen: R = @Mapped[@which]
 export const out: path = @Chosen.p
}
instance One = Pick(which: 0)
instance Two = Pick(which: 1)
const First: path = @One::out
const Second: path = @Two::out
const L: number = @First.length
const M: number = @Second.length
